meta.title: Replace `pre-commit install` with `pre-commit install --install-hooks`
meta.body_summary: Add --install-hooks flag to all pre-commit install commands to ensure hooks are installed immediately, improving dev environment setup efficiency.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added --install-hooks flag to pre-commit commands; harupy requested removal of hook type options and PR merged after fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Tiny 18-line config change across 6 files; typical for a workflow improvement PR, merged quickly after minor review comment about hook type options.

review_details.concern_detail: harupy suggested removing explicit hook type options (-t pre-commit -t prepare-commit-msg) from pre-commit install commands, as --install-hooks is sufficient without them. Copilot applied the changes in follow-up commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding --install-hooks flag ensures hooks are installed immediately, making dev environment setup more efficient and predictable.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple, well-scoped configuration change; Copilot handled flag addition and review feedback seamlessly.

detection_detail.code_reading: harupy reviewed the diff and requested removal of unnecessary hook type options in inline comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No quantitative performance data provided or requested; claim of efficiency improvement is narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot applied three commits to remove hook type options from .devcontainer/postCreate.sh, CONTRIBUTING.md, and dev/dev-env-setup.sh after reviewer feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced `pre-commit install -t pre-commit -t prepare-commit-msg` with `pre-commit install --install-hooks` in six files; subsequently removed explicit hook type options from three of those files per review.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (26b832b6): added --install-hooks flag to all six occurrences.
After review, Copilot removed hook type options from postCreate.sh (5343d43), CONTRIBUTING.md (f342a9f), and dev-env-setup.sh (98f2bf9).

review_signals.summary: Suggested removing -t pre-commit -t prepare-commit-msg from pre-commit install in .devcontainer/postCreate.sh.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial plan and first commit adding --install-hooks.
harupy reviewed within 10 minutes, inline-suggested removal of hook type options in three files.
Copilot responded with sequential commits removing hook type options.
harupy marked ready for review, added 'rn/none' label, and commented 'LGTM'.
